expected_behavior: Both scatter_add and scatter_reduce(sum) must place 16 ones in rows 0 and 2, yielding row sums [16.0, 0.0, 16.0]. A contiguous-index control matches an explicitly constructed full reference tensor.
bug_signature: Expanded-index stride (1,0) makes scatter_add and scatter_reduce(sum) write sixteen ones into rows 0 and 1 instead of rows 0 and 2. Full tensors, not only row sums, are checked; contiguous-index controls match the correct reference.
